page.overview:
Who is Costin III?

Emperor Costin III was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 1940–1955 AG) during the Era of the Princes, succeeding Corrin V as ruler of the Corrino Imperium. Costin was a grandson of Emperor Irulon I.

Costin was succeeded in 1955 by Sidir VII.
